name: neon_loops
description: neon outline: glowing white loops and beams, each one clean weight with a soft halo, over the set's pale lace on a blue-to-green ground
reuses: the radial channel (a calm ground, the map's lower 0.6)
de glows for the set's lace and its aura
notes: The stroke trap is item 062's primitive, for five references whose look is a clean continuous curve drawn like a pen stroke (visionary-spires, ten-leaf-clover, tinan, tianan, sear-the-sky). A line through the critical value (`on_c`) pulls back as stars joined by long curves, a circle as closed loops; the distance is taken in the frame, so a stroke keeps one weight along its whole pullback, which the strip trap's blades and a `de` glow do not. Three stacks came of it: mercury_tubes (lit tubes), neon_loops (glowing outlines; tan_star_beams is its palette entry, round one's cream_ribbons kept nothing) and hairline_rays (hairlines at `taper` 0).

A circle stroke (the loops) and a line stroke (the beams), each drawn twice off its `glow` read: a wide halo at `power` 0.3 and a white core at 2. The map's layout is the mode's contract with its entries: the ground in the lower 0.6 (the radial channel at `cycles` 0.6), the halo at 0.75, the lace at 0.88, the line at 1.0. tan_star_beams (tianan: the lace wide and tan, the beams blue-white) is the same stack with other numbers; so was cream_ribbons (tinan: the loops faint hairlines, broad soft beams, a dark ground at gamma 2.5), which kept nothing and left the library.

Round one's lessons: a halo at `power` under about 0.3 on a wide beam floods the ground in the halo's colour; `steps` 10 and `smallest` 0.12 keep the outlines few. Readings: n_loops (no beams), n_thin (half the weight).

Explorer cost (080, `style cost`, read beside other Node workers: an upper bound): 22 s as WebAssembly on one thread at 1280x800 ss2 at its deepest kept seat (phoenix_8b21e0ae, maxiter 5,001), under the 5-minute bar.

Entry violet_threads (item 092, round one; wallhaven-r21py7, glowing violet threads round bright orbs): the stack as it is, its loops and beams the threads and its star nodes the orbs, at the reference's dark tone (0.106/0.019) in a violet map running to a pink white; it holds both of the mode's kept seats (phoenix_fc131a7f and phoenix_8b21e0ae). mercury_tubes in ym8rqk's glow_tube map is drawn beside light_pillar's glow_tube entry for comparison.
